minutes.headline: Finance Committee recommended the FY17 operating budget and stabilization transfer; other articles held for Town Meeting.
minutes.summary: The committee finished its warrant article review ahead of annual town meeting. It voted to recommend the operating budget, the stabilization transfer and the water enterprise fund, and held several others for Town Meeting. It also reviewed the draft budget letter, approved minutes, and agreed to skip a meeting.

what_happened.line: The Finance Committee voted to recommend Article 15, the FY17 operating budget, as written.
It voted to recommend Article 17, a transfer to the stabilization fund, and the FY17 water department enterprise fund.
The committee held its recommendation until Town Meeting on the solid waste article, the road maintenance debt exclusion, and the inflow infiltration and reserve capacity stabilization funds.
The turf field, Brooks House custody and bylaw articles were also held for Town Meeting.
The committee agreed to skip the next week's meeting; the next meeting is April 28.

why_it_matters: The operating budget and stabilization transfer are the articles that set the town's spending and savings for FY17, and residents will be asked to vote on them at annual Town Meeting.

The road maintenance debt exclusion and other held articles reach Town Meeting without a committee recommendation, so voters will decide them without that guidance; a debt exclusion would add to tax bills.
watch_next: Annual Town Meeting votes on the held articles, including the road maintenance debt exclusion.
The committee's next meeting on April 28.
